invariants.statement: Server total always equals session price in cents multiplied by party size, with no tax, fee, deposit, discount, or gratuity.
Bookings belong to one authenticated site-local account and cannot oversell a session or be read by another account.
Source mutation, real email, Stripe test, live payment, messages, push, PR, deployment, and production network effects remain zero.
acceptance_obligations: Runtime CSP permits same-origin requests only.
Booking accepts opaque local-sandbox scenario IDs and rejects payment credential fields.

invariants.statement: Confirmed or rescheduled bookings can change only at least 48 hours before class start; cancelled bookings cannot change.
